text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Now, the mock race reaches the endgame! 
And here comes Satono Crown! She looks 
ready to make a move!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Breaking free from the pack with clever 
tactics! A brilliant late surge, crossing 
the finish line in 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That was an incredible run, Kura-chan! 
Your positioning and the timing of your 
final burst were both spot on...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! It's all thanks to our prep work 
and thorough strategy meeting! Our plan 
worked like a charm, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Ever since signing an exclusive 
contract, Kura-chan's tactics have really 
been polished, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I can't fall behind either... For the 
sake of the Satono family, I have to 
become stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we lit a fire in Dia's heart. I 
wonder just how fast she'll become...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"No way! If anything, I'm all fired up 
now!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, I will never 
flinch. Because—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"After all, I've got a reliable partner 
right by my side! Isn't that right?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident! The star of this coronation 
is none other than me!!
